name: Alex Morgan
title: Digital Marketing Specialist
summary: Marketing specialist with 4 years of experience in paid social, SEO and lifecycle email. Comfortable owning a budget, running experiments and reporting results to leadership.

Built a weekly A/B testing routine for landing pages, lifting conversion rate from 2.1% to 3.4%
Launched a 5-step onboarding email flow that **drove 18% of first-year revenue** from new customers

entries.name: Marketing Coordinator
bullets: Grew organic search traffic 3x in 12 months through a 40-article content plan
Coordinated 12 in-store events per year with local partners and tracked attendance and sales

entries.name: Holiday Gift Guide Campaign
bullets: Planned and shipped the campaign in 3 weeks; generated $250K in sales at a 4.2x return on ad spend
